stop.t: Do Lucia's balcony meditation before Tourist Trap — it is gone when Chapter 1 ends.

steps.t: Play the story; save in a spare slot before Tourist Trap.
Beat Cal's fishing challenge while Jason still has his boat.
Start scanning vehicles and animals with WAiNK from day one.
Coffee Break unlocks the partner: Hot Together and partner trophies open.
Hit Kingpin Bowling and start Billy's and Bret's strands.
Begin buying garages and registering cars through Moses.

stop.t: Race Against Yago is timed (hourglass) — run it the moment it appears.

steps.t: Jewelry jobs: Sneakthief, then Retail Therapy across three stores.
Key Cloner opens Randy's list and the showroom Banshee.
Start Andy, Tyrone and the stranger strands as they ring.
Take That's Where The Money Is… after the VCIA job: first vault.
Vault escapes also give A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together.

stop.t: Save before the final mission; its choice decides the ending.

steps.t: Credits return you to free roam before the finale.

stages.title: Free-roam sweep
stages.chapters: Any chapter · do alongside the story

steps.t: Tank, jet, UFO, bike kicks and the rooftop cocktail are one-off stops.
Shooting ranges and drone races also level Focus for Gunslinger.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear each line.
Stunts and challenges pop their trophies on the way.

pnr.label: Before Tourist Trap: balcony meditation
pnr.t: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude is lost when Chapter 1 ends.

pnr.label: Race Against Yago expires
pnr.t: Yago's timed race can expire; his strand counts for Strangers & Freaks.

pnr.label: Final mission: save first
pnr.t: The finale's choice sets the ending; keep a save before it.

safeNote.t: Everything else stays open after the credits — the 100% checklist itself has nothing missable.
